item.description:
​​📊 Bitcoin ETF Inflows Follow Price Rather Than Predict It

Strong Bitcoin ETF inflows are often seen as a bullish signal, yet historical data shows they are far more closely linked to past BTC returns than future price movements.

Across 694 trading days since January 2024, US spot Bitcoin ETF flows showed a correlation of 0.54 with BTC returns over the previous five trading days, compared to just 0.03 over the following five days.
